Use the `offline-architect` agent with `token-efficient-work`, `offline-data` and `sync-protocol`.

Review only the offline-relevant paths first.

## Output

1. Observed facts with file evidence.
2. Current service-worker and PWA status.
3. Offline capability matrix.
4. IndexedDB/local repository assessment.
5. Synchronization design.
6. Conflict and deletion policy.
7. Authentication and tenant implications.
8. iOS/iPadOS limitations.
9. Prioritized findings.
10. Tests, metrics and ADRs required.

Do not claim that a feature works offline solely because a service worker exists.
